title: Saudi Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with tender beef and a blend of aromatic spices. This recipe is gluten-free and perfect for a cold winter's day.

ingredients.name: arabian herbal tea
ingredients.notes: used for flavoring and tenderizing the beef

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then remove it from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Saudi stew spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, browned beef, and chopped onion to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the velvety tomatoes and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
